title: PANDORA IN RIO
sub: FOOH, event IDs and an opening film for one visual universe.
body: Pandora in Rio brings together different scales of the same visual experience. Charms appear in recognizable Rio de Janeiro locations; identity films explore light, materials and motion; and a 3D opening introduces the event’s world. The case also includes a selection of styleframes from the visual development.
focus: The object as a starting point: changing its scale, exploring its material qualities and turning it into an identity that moves between the city and its screens.

title: CONTINUOUS REFLE(A)CTION 2.0
body: Two ten-second films created around the concept “Back to Nature” for Continuous Refle(a)ction 2.0, Morcreate Beijing’s virtual eco-art exhibition. Factory transforms a factory suspended among clouds into a structure of wind turbines and vegetation. Flowers approaches the same change at another scale: flowers spread across the ground, opening the image onto an urban landscape.
focus: Telling a story of transformation in ten seconds. Industry and the city change through color, growth and camera movement.
context: Morcreate Beijing / exposición virtual de ecoarte

title: MTV / BULL ON DRUGS
sub: From a simple gesture to an explosion of color
body: An MTV ident designed and animated by Lucas Casagrande for Bluna. The bull and bullfighter first appear in a spare composition against a flat background. A sweep of the cape opens a world of floating characters, repetition and saturated color that fills the screen around the brand.
focus: Using contrast to drive the story: a restrained scene becomes a psychedelic universe in just ten seconds.
role: Full design and animation / for Bluna
